description: Send a natural-language intent and optionally any dimensions you already know (tool, skill, model, input fields). Fills only the blanks via Jev, then either executes the call or returns a ready-to-run use_tool payload. Explicit values are never overridden. Returns candidates when confidence is low or no tool fits. Flow: route → if confident and complete, result is returned; otherwise use the pre-filled call with use_tool.

input.description: Optional. Partial skill input — explicit fields are never overridden.

intent.description: What you want to do, in plain language.

max_cost.description: Optional. Max USD to spend; above this returns a pre-filled call instead of executing.

model.description: Optional. Model override — honoured verbatim when set.

skill.description: Optional. Skill name — honoured verbatim when set.

tool.description: Optional. Tool name — honoured verbatim when set.

name: route
title: Route Intent
